item.title: Long-Sought Proof Tames Some of Math's Unruliest Equations
item.description:
📝 Mathematicians haven’t been able to show that their solutions are regular. Mathematicians describe situations like this using what are called elliptic PDEs. In the decades since Schauder’s proof, mathematicians have shown that this condition is enough to ensure that any PDE that describes a nice, “uniform” material has regular solutions.

item.title: Discord Launches Teen-by-Default Settings Globally
item.description:
📝 Straightforward verification: In most cases, users complete the process once and their Discord experience adapts to their verified age group. ‍Default Safety SettingsStarting in early March, all new and existing Discord users globally will be assigned new default settings that support age-appropriate experiences while keeping privacy front and center:Content Filters: Discord users will need to be age-assured as adults in order to unblur sensitive content or turn off the setting. ‍Giving Teens a Seat at the Table: Introducing the Discord Teen CouncilAlong with enhanced teen safety features, Discord is announcing recruitment for its inaugural Teen Council, a teen advisory body that brings authentic teen perspectives into how Discord shapes their experience.
🔗 Read more: https://discord.com/press-releases/discord-launches-teen-by-default-settings-globally
